segments.text: Ok so this is the components surfaces page for LangGraph Python, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the agent uses render UI to fill the surface, umm, but nothing renders it.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for cheap running shoes in the featured area, it should update that area, but it stays the same, nothing changes.
So yeah, the agent calls render UI, but no renderer is registered for it, so the featured products never update, three runs in a row.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
